content: Safari's History.db is a standard SQLite/WAL store (History.db-wal/-shm/-lock siblings); reading it while Safari runs is possible in WAL mode but copying/moving it fails or errors while Safari holds it open, and it lives inside a data-vault requiring Full Disk Access. No confirmed macOS-version-specific corruption risk found, but WAL checkpoint timing means a live read can race an in-progress Safari write.
